summary: End-to-end verification of (A) image drag bug fix, (B) new Ticker-bar element, (C) Messages per-row Live toggle. Backend: 9 passed, 1 skipped (no pre-existing scenes in workspace to regression-test overlay export at root; overlay tested via newly-created ticker scene instead). test_ticker.py validates: POST /submissions/{sid}/ticker toggles on/off; GET /forms/{fid}/ticker-items returns submission text when ticker=true and omits when false; GET /public/scene/{token}/ticker/{form_id} returns the same items (unauth); GET /public/scene/{token}/overlay contains 'clara-ticker' keyframe + ticker branch; GET /sources/values regression OK. Frontend (yannick admin + MFA, cookie auth): (1) BUG FIX: created a scene with an image element (src=placeholder.png) and verified ; mouse-down on image body + move +200/+100 then up moved the element bounding rect by exactly (+200,+100) — no native image ghost-drag intercept. (2) 'Add element' list includes add-ticker; clicking creates a ticker layer visible in LayersPanel. (3) Properties panel for ticker exposes prop-ticker-form, prop-ticker-text, prop-ticker-icon, prop-ticker-speed; filling freeText 'Welcome to Radio GRK test' renders scrolling text in the canvas with the chosen separator (●) even without a form. (4) Messages page: message-ticker-{sid} button toggles 'Live' → 'Live in ticker' (brand-filled), triggers POST /submissions/{sid}/ticker, and the ticker-items endpoint confirms the backend state. Toast 'Removed from ticker' shown when toggled off. All seed data (scene, form, submission) cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _submission_ticker_text uses U+00B7 (middle dot) as join separator between fields but the overlay JS buildElementNode ticker branch uses (p.icon||'\u25CF') as the separator between items. The two separators look similar but are intentionally different scopes (within-submission vs between-items). OK.

toggle_submission_ticker does not return 404 when the submission does not belong to the user — it silently updates 0 rows and returns {ok:true, ticker:on}. Minor: consider raising 404 for missing/foreign submissions for correctness and auditability.
public_ticker_items looks up form by {id, user_id: scene.user_id}; if a form is in a different user's workspace it quietly returns []. Acceptable.

overlay HTML embeds BACKEND via BACKEND constant used by pullTicker; verified clara-ticker keyframe present. Animation duration = max(8, round(len(one) * speed)) seconds — speed=0.35 default -> plausible.

elementRender.jsx image branch: draggable={false} + pointerEvents:'none' + WebkitUserDrag:'none' + userSelect:'none' is the correct combination to disable native image drag across Chrome/Safari/Firefox. Verified via live DOM inspection.

Note: when an image element has NO src, the renderer falls back to a image placeholder which does NOT have the draggable fix — but it also has no native drag behaviour since it's not an , so the fix is effectively complete.
